title: Random and Sequential Order Finger Motor Imagery
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 20 participants performing a finger motor imagery paradigm, in which finger cues were presented in either random or sequential block order, with starting order counterbalanced across participants. The data were collected to investigate motor imagery-related EEG activity across different cue ordering conditions, using a 65-channel g.tec EEG system sampled at 512 Hz.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a g.tec GmbH system with 65 channels (62 EEG, 2 reference, 1 marker) at a sampling frequency of 512 Hz. Participants performed finger motor imagery tasks cued in random or sequential block order, with block order counterbalanced across subjects.

funding_references.funder_name: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
